acquisition.network_policy: HTTPS only; reject redirects outside allowed_redirect_hosts; verify exact byte count and SHA-256 before atomic cache publication

acquisition_replay.blocker: Run the locked acquisition in a clean Rocky 10.2 environment and retain a machine-readable transcript that includes the cache artifact digest.

dist_git_object_replay.blocker: Fetch the exact tag and commit in a clean environment, verify every locked Git blob and tag peel, and retain the transcript.

repository_metadata_signature_replay.blocker: Re-fetch the pinned Rocky release key, repomd.xml, detached signature, and primary metadata; verify their locked hashes and signature in a clean environment; retain the machine-readable transcript.

srpm_header_signature.blocker: Capture an rpmkeys verification of the downloaded SRPM against the pinned Rocky Linux 10 release key, including signer fingerprint and signature algorithm.
